Stage 2: source_dependencies; work sample 0.
Implement evaluate(request, policy). Return {needs_review, changed}. Compare canonical JSON source states for every unique declared path except policy.ignored. An absent state equals {kind:missing}. Compare complete states, not names or timestamps. Return sorted changed paths. Irrelevant changes do not require review. Do not modify inputs.
Write work.py with this API. Also write report.json as a JSON array of evaluate results for requests.json, using current policy.json and evidence.json when present. Keep prior supported behavior. Use actual local checks. Store findings and unresolved limits for the next agent.

import copy,json
from work import evaluate

cases=[
 ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':['b']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':1,'meta':{'b':2,'a':1}}},'current':{'x':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'timestamp':2,'name':'same','kind':'file'}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','v':1}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','v':1},'z':{'kind':'file','v':2}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
]
for req,pol,want in cases:
 rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)
 got=evaluate(req,pol)
 assert got==want,(got,want)
 assert req==rb and pol==pb
requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
report=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
print('all checks passed')
